refutation: stronger prediction makes the mix MORE harmful, the opposite of the hypothesis, with a Q4-Q1 gap of -10.29 pp
reconciliation_with_R37: R37/R48 had pool 21,652 at rho about 0.32 with the mix helping; this round at rho about 0.35 has pool about 825 with the mix hurting. Pools differ 20-fold and R51's curve predicts negativity for small pools, so rho effects and pool-size effects are distinct.
